selected.directMethodAudit: Burst method includes status setup, A1 invocation, and HP-drain scheduling only; no QueueAttack site and no later ability helper is called from that method. The zero count is the native direct damage-root count, not a claim that the state has no effect.

Burst method queues one initial grenade at burst.go:62-67 and eight secondary shells in the fixed 5-group loop at 78-93; the loop counts are hard-coded 1+2+2+2+1. Total is 9 QueueAttack roots independent of enemy count. c.c4() only opens later E hold availability.
